Only “Shake” is recognised today. Double-shake and flip & shake come from the design prototype and are not implemented yet — detection keeps using Shake.
Exempt from Android’s battery optimisation (the Doze allowlist). Vendor restrictions are reported separately below.
On Android’s battery-optimisation list, so Doze can ignore the wake lock and stop detection with the screen off.

On XOS/HiOS these are separate switches, and ShakeIT can only read the first: Battery & power saving → App management → ShakeIT → Unrestricted / allow background activity; Auto-start or Startup manager → allow ShakeIT; Phone Master → App freezer / background management → do not freeze ShakeIT; then lock ShakeIT’s card in Recents so the cleaner skips it.

On MIUI/HyperOS these are separate switches, and ShakeIT can only read the first: Settings → Battery → battery saver → No restrictions for ShakeIT; Apps → Permissions → Autostart → allow ShakeIT; Security → Boost speed / clear background → do not clean ShakeIT; then lock ShakeIT’s card in Recents.
If detection stops after a few minutes, set ShakeIT’s battery usage to Unrestricted and disable any per-app background limit.
